question: Should this PR retain the v2 device-auth payload and public credential/identity reset APIs, or be narrowed to the WebSocket ping crash repair?
rationale: Those auth changes are not needed to explain the reported continuation crash and alter a compatibility-sensitive public surface; the intended gateway-version and reset contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow to the ping repair
options.body: Remove the device-auth payload and reset-helper changes, leaving a focused continuation-safety fix with regression and runtime proof.

options.title: Sponsor the combined auth change
options.body: Keep the added auth APIs only after confirming their compatibility, migration, and public API contract in a separately documented review.

recommendation.title: Narrow to the ping repair
recommendation.body: Remove the device-auth payload and reset-helper changes, leaving a focused continuation-safety fix with regression and runtime proof.
